name: Happy Path — Personal Loan Application and Drawdown
description: Existing customer applies for £10,000 personal loan over 36 months. Automated credit assessment approves at APR 6.9%. Customer accepts offer and signs agreement via SCA. Funds disbursed within 60 seconds.

steps.action: Select loan amount £10,000, term 36 months, purpose home_improvement
GET /loans/eligibility?amount=10000&term_months=36 (soft check)
200 OK {eligible: true, indicative_apr: '5.9%-12.9%', monthly_repayment_indicative: '~305'}
Display SECCI form + indicative APR range. Customer reviews and acknowledges.
Complete income/expenditure form (£3,500/month income, £1,200/month expenditure) + SCA
POST /sca/validate {assertion}
200 OK {valid: true}
POST /loans/applications {loan_amount: 10000, term: 36, income: 3500, expenditure: 1200, secci_acknowledged: true, sca_assertion_ref}
Create LoanApplication (status=submitted)
202 Accepted {application_id, poll_url}
Publish LoanApplicationSubmitted (EVT-152)
Consume EVT-152 → Run hard credit bureau search + DTI calculation + affordability stress test
Consume EVT-152 → AML monitoring setup for loan origination
Publish CreditAssessmentCompleted (EVT-153) {approval_decision: approved, risk_band: B, recommended_apr: '6.9%', monthly_repayment: '308.22'}
Consume EVT-153 → Update LoanApplication status=approved; create LoanOffer
GET /loans/applications/{id} (customer polling)
200 OK {status: offer_presented, offer: {apr: 6.9%, monthly_repayment: 308.22, total_repayable: 11095.92, withdrawal_right_days: 14}}
Display loan offer: APR 6.9%, £308.22/month, £11,095.92 total repayable, 14-day withdrawal right
Review and accept full credit agreement + complete SCA to sign electronically
POST /sca/validate {assertion}
200 OK {valid: true}
POST /loans/applications/{id}/accept {agreement_accepted: true, sca_assertion_ref, nominated_account_id}
Create LoanAgreement (status=executed); create LoanAccount (status=pending_disbursement)
Publish LoanAgreementExecuted (EVT-154)
Consume EVT-154 → Record consumer credit agreement for CONC reporting
Consume EVT-154 → Execute loan drawdown transfer to nominated_account_id (£10,000)
Consume EVT-154 → Write immutable agreement execution audit record
Update LoanAccount status=active; outstanding_balance=10000
Publish LoanDrawdownCompleted (EVT-155)
Consume EVT-155 → Dispatch disbursement confirmation: £10,000 credited, first repayment [date], £308.22/month
Consume EVT-155 → Write drawdown audit record
